name: White-shouldered Bumble Bee
desc: White-shouldered Bumble Bee (Bombus appositus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 29 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus appositus is a species of bumblebee known commonly as the white-shouldered bumblebee. It is native to western North America, including western Canada and the western United States.
